# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] crewai: Candidate Profile to Job Matching with CrewAI & IBM Db2 Vector Search`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/crewai/`

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** Candidate Profile to Job Matching with CrewAI & IBM Db2 Vector Search
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/crewai/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** An enterprise multi-agent candidate-to-position matching system featuring local offline IBM Granite embeddings, decoupled Haystack 2.x Db2 ingestion, and CrewAI DB2VectorSearchTool similarity search.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Eliminates keyword search limitations in recruiting by providing semantic understanding of candidate competencies and jobs with zero external embedding API cost or latency. Target audience: Enterprise recruitment squads, hiring managers, and HR tech platforms.

---

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** CrewAI Db2 Innovators
- **Team Members:**

| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
|---|---|---|
| Pawan | @PawanThakurIBM | Pawan.thakur1@ibm.com / AI & Backend Developer |

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 Database with Native Vector capability.
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Serves as the central high-performance vector store and relational metadata database storing job descriptions, requirements, and 768-dimensional embeddings in `JOB_POSTINGS` table.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** Official Haystack 2.x `IBMDb2DocumentStore`, `ibm_db`, and official CrewAI `DB2VectorSearchTool` with custom local Granite embedding function.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** `JOB_POSTINGS` table containing `ID VARCHAR(128)`, `CONTENT CLOB`, `DATAFRAME CLOB`, `BLOB_DATA BLOB`, `BLOB_MIME_TYPE VARCHAR(128)`, `META CLOB`, `EMBEDDING VECTOR(768, FLOAT32)`.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** Run `python -m src.ingestion.ingest_jobs_haystack` followed by `python -m src.match_to_proposal.main`.

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.11
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** CrewAI, Haystack 2.x (`ibm-db-haystack`), PyTorch, Sentence-Transformers
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** CrewAI & Haystack 2.x
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** `ibm-granite/granite-embedding-311m-multilingual-r2` (Local Embeddings) and `granite3.3:8b` (Local Ollama reasoning)
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** Local Granite model generates dense vector embeddings for jobs and CV search queries; CrewAI multi-agent crew (`cv_reader` and `matcher`) extracts candidate competencies, executes vector distance retrieval against Db2, and evaluates candidate alignment.

---

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- **External Source Repo (if hosted separately):** https://github.com/PawanThakurIBM/IBM_Db2_TechX_Project_Submission/tree/submission/crewai

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/crewai/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `crewai` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/crewai/README.md` and `submissions/crewai/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/crewai/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/crewai/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
